payload._note: Xencor is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with no marketed drugs under its own name. However, three XmAb Fc domain-engineered medicines are marketed by partners: Ultomiris (ravulizumab-cwvz) by Alexion, Monjuvi/Minjuvi (tafasitamab-cxix) by Incyte, and sotrovimab (Xevudy) by Vir/GSK. Xencor receives royalties from these products. In 2023, royalty revenue was $49.5 million (Ultomiris: $38.6M, sotrovimab: $2.2M, Monjuvi not separately disclosed). Xencor sold portions of its Ultomiris and Monjuvi royalty streams to OMERS Life Sciences in November 2023 for $215.0 million upfront. The company has 22 clinical-stage drug candidates or marketed medicines developed with XmAb technologies. Xencor is prioritizing its CD3 T-cell engaging bispecific antibodies (XmAb819, XmAb808, XmAb541) and vudalimab. Development of cytokine programs XmAb564 and XmAb662 will be paused in H1 2024. Revenue concentration cannot be precisely calculated from the filing, but royalty revenue ($49.5M) and milestone payments ($31.0M from Genentech milestone and $5.0M from Omeros, $6.0M from Gilead, and $20.0M Ultomiris milestone = $62M total milestone/royalty) comprised a significant portion of 2023 revenue. Orange Book data is not applicable as Xencor has no FDA-approved drugs under its own NDA/BLA.
